```mcstas
# RTP_DIF instrument file
# Parameters: lambda=2.36, DM=3.355, Mono_tilt=0, powder=Na2Ca3Al2F14.laz, det_rotation=45

# Define parameters
lambda = 2.36
DM = 3.355
Mono_tilt = 0
powder = "Na2Ca3Al2F14.laz"
det_rotation = 45

# Calculate monochromator take-off angle
take_off_angle_deg = 2 * asin(lambda / (2 * DM)) * RAD2DEG

# Define components
component Progress_bar {
    type Progress_bar
    parameters {
        length = 1.0
    }
}

component Source_gen {
    type Source_gen
    parameters {
        radius = 0.154 / 2
        dist = 1.16 + 1.50
        focus_xw = 0.11
        focus_yh = 0.03
        lambda0 = lambda
        dlambda = 0.2
        I1 = 2.79e12 / 4 / PI
        T1 = 300
    }
}

component Guide {
    type Guide
    parameters {
        w1 = 0.154
        h1 = 0.154
        l = 1.16125
        m = 0
    }
}

component Monitor_nD {
    type Monitor_nD
    parameters {
        xwidth = 0.11
        yheight = 0.11
        bins = 50
        options = "slit disk, auto wavelength"
    }
}

component Arm {
    type Arm
    parameters {
        length = 0.147 + 0.15 / 2
        split = 10
    }
}

component Monochromator_curved {
    type Monochromator_curved
    parameters {
        reflect = "HOPG.rfl"
        transmit = "HOPG.trm"
        NH = 1
        NV = 1
        mosaich = 48
        mosaicv = 48
        RV = 0
        RH = 0
        DM = DM
        width = 0.11
        height = 0.03
    }
}

component PowderN {
    type PowderN
    parameters {
        reflections = "V.lau"
        radius = 0.01 / 2
        yheight = 0.04
        thickness = -50e-6
        p_transmit = 0.95
        d_phi = 50
        concentric = 1
    }
}

component Monitor_nD {
    type Monitor_nD
    parameters {
        xwidth = 0.12
        yheight = 0.12
        bins = 50
        options = "x y"
    }
}

component Monitor_nD {
    type Monitor_nD
    parameters {
        xwidth = 0.02
        yheight = 0.02
        bins = 50
        options = "disk slit, x y"
    }
}

component Monitor_nD {
    type Monitor_nD
    parameters {
        yheight = 0.5
        radius = 1
        options = "banana theta limits=[-150 150] bins=300, y bins=64"
    }
}

component Monitor_nD {
    type Monitor_nD
    parameters {
        xwidth = 0.5
        yheight = 0.0254
        bins = 25
        options = "x"
    }
}

component Shape {
    type Shape
    parameters {
        radius = 0.7 / 2
        yheight = 0.4
    }
}

# Define instrument
instrument RTP_DIF {
    # Origin
    Progress_bar AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

    # Source
    Source_gen AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE Origin ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

    # Coarse collimators
    Guide AT [0, 0, 0.01] RELATIVE source ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE
    Guide AT [0, 0, 1.16125 + 0.003] RELATIVE CoarseCollimator1 ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

    # Lmon monitor
    Monitor_nD AT [0, 0, 1.5 + 0.01] RELATIVE CoarseCollimator2 ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

    # Be position
    Arm AT [0, 0, 0.147 + 0.15 / 2] RELATIVE lmon ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

    # Mono cradle
    Arm AT [0, 0, 0.145 + 0.15 / 2 + 0.176] RELATIVE Be_Position ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

    # Mono rotation
    Arm AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE mono_cradle ROTATED [0, -asin(lambda / (2 * DM)) * RAD2DEG, 0] RELATIVE mono_cradle
    EXTEND: mono_index = 0

    # Mono1
    Monochromator_curved AT [-0.01, 0, 0] RELATIVE mono_rotation ROTATED [0, Mono_tilt, 0] RELATIVE mono_rotation
    EXTEND: if (SCATTERED) mono_index = 1

    # Mono2
    Monochromator_curved AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE mono_rotation ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE mono_rotation
    EXTEND: if (SCATTERED) mono_index = 2

    # Mono3
    Monochromator_curved AT [0.01, 0, 0] RELATIVE mono_rotation ROTATED [0, -Mono_tilt, 0] RELATIVE mono_rotation
    EXTEND: if (SCATTERED) mono_index = 3

    # Mono take-off
    Arm AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE mono_cradle ROTATED [0, -take_off_angle_deg, 0] RELATIVE mono_cradle

    # PSD transmit monitor
    Monitor_nD AT [0, 0, 0.25] RELATIVE mono_cradle ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE
    GROUP: mono_rt

    # PSD reflect monitor
    Monitor_nD AT [0, 0, 0.574] RELATIVE mono_takeoff ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE
    GROUP: mono_rt

    # Sample PSD monitor
    Monitor_nD AT [0, 0, 0.575 + 0.5] RELATIVE mono_takeoff ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

    # Sample position
    Arm AT [0, 0, 0.575 + 0.5 + 0.01] RELATIVE mono_takeoff ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE
    SPLIT: 100

    # Container in
    PowderN AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE sample_position ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

    # Sample
    PowderN AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE sample_position ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE
    EXTEND: if (!SCATTERED) ABSORB

    # Container out
    PowderN AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE sample_position ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

    # Sample out
    Arm AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE sample_position ROTATED [0, det_rotation, 0] RELATIVE sample_position

    # Det big
    Monitor_nD AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE sample_position ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

    # Det
    Monitor_nD AT [0, 0, 1] RELATIVE sample_out ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

    # Reactor
    Shape AT [0, 0, -0.35] RELATIVE Origin ROTATED [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE ABSOLUTE
}

# Run the instrument
run {
    lambda = 2.36
    DM = 3.355
    Mono_tilt = 0
    powder = "Na2Ca3Al2F14.laz"
    det_rotation = 45
    seed = 123456789
    ncount = 1e6
    wait_s = 0
}

# Report results
report {
    monitor lmon
    monitor psd_transmit
    monitor psd_reflect
    monitor sample_psd
    monitor det_big
    monitor det
}
```
